dct_description_sm:
The official geographical names data are provided by the federal, provincial and territorial naming authorities of the Geographical Names Board of Canada (GNBC). The data within this dataset is provided as administered by the Surveys and Mapping section of GIS and Mapping Division.

For more information on this dataset, please refer to the Canadian Geographical Names Database here, or contact the Surveys and Mapping section of the GIS and Mapping Division. 

For undersea and maritime features, the federal naming authority focused on the maritime context is the Advisory Committee on Undersea Feature Names (ACUFN). ACUFN reviews and examines name submissions for undersea and surface maritime features that are within Canadian waters and/or in areas of particular interest to Canada. For more information about ACUFN, contact ACUFN-CCNESM@dfo-mpo.gc.ca.

Last Updated: January 2025
